title: COME TO THE SAVIOUR, MAKE NO DELAY288
author: George F. Root
stanzas: Come to the Saviour, make no delay, Here in His word He's shown us the way; Herein our midst He's standing today, Tenderly saying: Come!
"Suffer the children!" O Hear his voice! Let every Heart leap forth and rejoice, And let us freely make him our choice; Do not delay, but come.
Think once again, He's with us today; Heed now his blest commands, and obey; Hear now his accents tenderly say: Come to your Saviour, come.
chorus: Joyful, joyful will the meeting be, When from sin our Hearts are pure and free, And we shall gather, Saviour, with thee In our eternal home.
